An '''IR suppressor''' was a [[Engine/Legends|engine]] component that was employed to hide exhaust heat from [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]]. They were incorporated into [[Exhaust Nacelle/Legends|Exhaust Nacelles]] to help hide hot exhaust waste from enemy [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] detection in ships such as the [[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom Corporation]] [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighter]].<ref name="SWS" />
